svg.title: An illustrative guideline passage, identified as text unit t1
svg.desc: The guide books each guest before the planetarium visit. The desk records every booking submitted by a guide. The guide welcomes guests at the desk before the show. This is a wholly fictional planetarium guideline example.

g.text: The guide books each guest before the planetarium visit.
The desk records every booking submitted by a guide.
The guide welcomes guests at the desk before the show.
